title: General theory of persistent microwave-optical quantum resources in hybrid-system dynamics
summary: We develop a general theoretical framework for characterizing persistent quantum resources between microwave and optical modes in the dynamics of chain-type hybrid quantum systems with intermediate modes. The effective Hamiltonian for microwave-optical (MO) squeezing is formulated via strong nearest-neighbor interactions in the microwave-intermediate-optical chain, from which rigorous solutions for the dynamics of MO Gaussian entanglement and quantum steering are obtained analytically.
